author: Vasilina Sidorova
developer_reply: Thanks for your love and feedback! The eye button in the upper right corner can control whether to display the completed tasks in the cycle. But this is only effective for today's plan and ongoing plan. Progress can only be displayed when you set the target number. You can open it in the Custom module first and set target num for your habit.
